defs.d: A person who dances, usually as a job or profession.
A stripper.
The whole duration of a being, whether animal, plant, or other kind, being alive.
The number of full years, months, days, hours, etc., that someone, or something, has been alive.
To cause to grow old; to impart the characteristics of age to.
defs.ex: Grief ages us.

defs.d: To postpone an action that would extinguish something, as a debt.
defs.ex: Money's a little tight right now, let's age our bills for a week or so.

defs.d: A moderate or refreshing state of cold; moderate temperature of the air between hot and cold; coolness.
defs.ex: in the cool of the morning

defs.d: A calm temperament.
Having a slightly low temperature; mildly or pleasantly cold.
Allowing or suggesting heat relief.
defs.ex: Linen has made cool and breathable clothing for millennia.

defs.d: (of people) To cause (someone) to be acquainted (with someone else).
defs.ex: Let me introduce you to my friends.

defs.d: To make (something or someone) known by formal announcement or recommendation.
defs.ex: Let me introduce our guest speaker.

defs.d: The game of tag, or it, in which the player attempting to catch the others is called "he".
The player attempting to catch the others in this game.
(personal) A male person or animal already known or implied.
(personal, sometimes proscribed, see usage notes) A person whose gender is unknown or irrelevant.
defs.ex: The rulebook clearly states that "if any student is caught cheating, he will be expelled", and you were caught cheating, were you not, Anna?

defs.d: (possibly nonstandard) Someone or something that is tall.
(of a person) Having a vertical extent greater than the average. For example, somebody with a height of over 6 feet would generally be considered to be tall.
defs.ex: Being tall is an advantage in basketball.

defs.d: (of a building, etc.) Having its top a long way up; having a great vertical (and often greater than horizontal) extent; high.
A place or building, consisting of a stage and seating, in which an audience gathers to watch plays, musical performances, public ceremonies, and so on.
A region where a particular action takes place; a specific field of action, usually with reference to war.
defs.ex: His grandfather was in the Pacific theater during the war.

defs.d: A being involved in the action of a story.
A distinguishing feature; characteristic; trait; phene.
defs.ex: A single locus governing the petal colour character was detected on the linkage group A2.

defs.d: To write (using characters); to describe.
The act of using.
defs.ex: The use of torture has been condemned by the United Nations.

defs.d: The act of consuming alcohol or narcotics.
To utilize or employ.
To accustom; to habituate. (Now common only in participial form. Uses the same pronunciation as the noun; see usage notes.)
defs.ex: soldiers who are used to hardships and danger

defs.d: A person, firm or other entity which pays for or hires the services of another person.
A person who is qualified or professionally engaged in any branch of engineering.
A title given to an engineer.
To design, construct or manage something as an engineer.
To alter or construct something by means of genetic engineering.
In the first place; before anything else; first.
Ability to do or undergo something.
(social) Ability to coerce, influence or control.
To provide power for (a mechanical or electronic device).
defs.ex: This CD player is powered by batteries.

defs.d: To hit or kick something forcefully.
Impressive.
An act of transporting; conveyance.
defs.ex: The transport of goods is not included in the price given on the website.

defs.d: The state of being transported by emotion; rapture.
To carry or bear from one place to another; to remove; to convey.
defs.ex: to transport goods; to transport troops

defs.d: To deport to a penal colony.
Something that is unusual; an anomaly.
Not usual, out of the ordinary
defs.ex: Every once in a while, though, Idol comes across an unusual talent who just blows everyone away.

defs.d: (of a person or their character) Having or showing ambition; wanting a lot of power, honor, respect, superiority, or other distinction.
defs.ex: an ambitious person

defs.d: (followed by "of" or the infinitive) Very desirous
An elongated depression between hills or mountains, often with a river flowing through it.
The area which drains into a river.
To end; to come to an end.
defs.ex: The story concluded with a moral.

defs.d: To bring to an end; to close; to finish.
Pertaining to an economy.
Frugal; cheap (in the sense of representing good value); economical.
The act of supplying.
defs.ex: supply and demand

defs.d: An amount of something supplied.
defs.ex: A supply of good drinking water is essential.

defs.d: To provide (something), to make (something) available for use.
defs.ex: to supply money for the war

defs.d: To furnish or equip with.
defs.ex: to supply a furnace with fuel; to supply soldiers with ammunition

defs.d: A committee that leads or governs (e.g. city council, student council).
Discussion or deliberation.
A strong feeling of displeasure, hostility or antagonism towards someone or something, usually combined with an urge to harm.
defs.ex: You need to control your anger.

defs.d: Pain or stinging.
To cause such a feeling of antagonism in.
defs.ex: He who angers you conquers you.

defs.d: To become angry.
defs.ex: You anger too easily.

defs.d: An event that causes a computer or other device to temporarily cease what it was doing and attend to a condition.
defs.ex: The interrupt caused the packet handler routine to run.

defs.d: To disturb or halt (an ongoing process or action, or the person performing it) by interfering suddenly.
defs.ex: A maverick politician repeatedly interrupted the debate by shouting.

defs.d: To divide; to separate; to break the monotony of.
defs.ex: The evenness of the road was not interrupted by a single hill.

defs.d: A question.
Search for truth, information or knowledge.
defs.ex: scientific enquiry

defs.d: The act, process, or result of reducing.
The amount or rate by which something is reduced, e.g. in price.
defs.ex: A 5% reduction in robberies
